title: Linear regression II
---

## Setup

Read the textbook chapter - [Linear regression II](https://websites.umich.edu/~thofer/teach/hhcr-book/linear_reg_2.html)

The examples and problems for this chapter can be loaded into Stata by running the following command:

```stata
run https://tphofer.github.io/ncsp-hhcr/code/lin_reg2.do
```

This command installs a number of programs which will facilitate the in-class work.
